clearance.derivation: systemic CL = apparent oral clearance CL/F (geometric mean 28.7 L/h at 10 mg) x absolute oral bioavailability F = 0.25, scaled to 70 kg (28.7 L/h x 0.25 = 7.18 L/h = 1.71 mL/min/kg)
